storage.description: A systematic approach to verifying that stored data matches expected configurations, ensuring data integrity and consistency across storage systems.
storage.name: Storage Reconciliation
principles: Accuracy - ensuring stored data matches the source of truth
Completeness - all required data is present and accounted for
Consistency - data remains consistent across all storage systems
Auditability - all reconciliation steps are documented and traceable
